remote_pr.observation_scope: Read during this acceptance review; local fixes have not been pushed.

scope: Original 33 future candidates plus 12 stratified boundary cases. Activity identity/city, calendar-day evidence, date roles, source attribution and safe disposition; no verification of every numerical/detail claim in article titles.
decision: Candidate disposition acceptance and factual verification are separate. Liu Yu satisfies the explicit withheld/pending exception; unknown facts stay not_verified. Strict release remains FAIL and the old remote PR is not recommended for merge.
qualifications: Date support is limited to the cited precision: Jinhua 08:00 and Nanning 07:30 are not promoted from auxiliary evidence to primary confirmation.
Non-event guide/roundup decisions only classify the source content, not every advertised event, price or ticket guarantee.
The Nanjing guide page exposes a title, author, metadata and platform AI summary; the AI summary is not treated as source facts or a full original article.
Race rules and advance announcements alone do not prove actual completion; separate after-event reports are identified where read.
Old source observations retain their original checked_at; quality_reviewed_at is the consolidated assessment time, not a claim that every source was reopened in this round.
Expanded four records are retained in the 49-row worksheet but do not silently replace any of the 45 required cases.
